changelog: Printable cards for the figurines: from a character, a sheet of paper strips to cut, fold and slide into the figurine, with the framing chosen in the app and blank cards to draw on. Settings: factory reset (characters, figurines, limits, PIN, name and, if chosen, Wi-Fi networks; every phone then finds Cucù as new), and a Space panel. Cucù always keeps 500 MB free on the SD card: uploads that would use it are refused, and updates do not start below 200 MB. From a computer, files can be dragged onto a character. Texts no longer assume a phone, nearby networks are collapsed in Settings, and the first character card no longer flashes.
